name: Aniracetam
addictionPotential: non-addictive with a low potential for abuse
summary: An anxiolytic nootropic which modulates the AMPA receptor. Significantly more potent than racetam. May have positive effects on memory and cognition. Little recreational value. Sold in Europe as a prescription drug, but not approved by the FDA in the US.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

milestones.label: Full tolerance
milestones.value: develops with prolonged and repeated use

pharmacology.text: Aniracetam has been shown to positively modulate the AMPA receptor. When ingested orally aniracetam is quickly broken down via first pass hepatic metabolism. The primary metabolites of aniracetam are N-anisoyl-GABA, (70–80%), 2-Pyrrolidinone and p-anisic acid (20–30%). There is some preliminary research suggesting that N-anisoyl-GABA and to a lesser degree p-ansic acid may contribute to the stimulatory effects of aniracetam in rats.

uses.text: Aniracetam has been used to treat dementia following stroke and in Alzheimer's disease. Results from human clinical trials were published in 1991 (one multi-center placebo-controlled study and a follow-up) and in 2011 (one open-label study).

summaryZh: 茴拉西坦是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C12H13NO3，屬於拉西坦類藥物，在歐洲作為處方藥銷售。
summaryZhHans: 茴拉西坦是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C12H13NO3，属于拉西坦类药物，在欧洲作为处方药销售。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects are usually mild and include headache, nausea, restlessness and trouble sleeping. It has not been through large long-term safety studies.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應通常輕微，包括頭痛、噁心、躁動不安與睡眠困難。它尚未經過大型的長期安全性研究。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应通常轻微，包括头痛、恶心、躁动不安与睡眠困难。它尚未经过大型的长期安全性研究。

fact.en: It is piracetam with a benzene ring added, which makes it fat soluble and more potent. The body breaks most of it down on first pass through the liver, and some of its effect comes from its breakdown products.
fact.zh: 茴拉西坦是在吡拉西坦上加一個苯環的產物，使它變得脂溶性且效力更強。它大部分在首次通過肝臟時就被分解，部分作用來自分解後的產物。
fact.zhHans: 茴拉西坦是在吡拉西坦上加一个苯环的产物，使它变得脂溶性且效力更强。它大部分在首次通过肝脏时就被分解，部分作用来自分解后的产物。
